weak_references.why: owner: a capability that passes every gate is never withheld for a weaker reference (2026-10-23)
weak_references.note: passed every gate; the reference is weaker than an independent computation (see notes)

notes.co2_radiative_forcing: quadrature of dF/dC = 5.35/C: the same logarithmic expression by another evaluation
notes.sp_epicentral_distance: brentq re-solves the arrival-time difference d/vs - d/vp = dt (the defining equation)
notes.airy_isostasy: equal pressure at the compensation depth by quadrature and brentq: the defining hydrostatic balance re-solved
notes.pratt_isostasy: equal column weight by quadrature and brentq: the defining hydrostatic balance re-solved
notes.gradient_wind: brentq re-solves the gradient-wind balance (the defining equation); only f comes from MetPy
notes.wave_dispersion: brentq re-solves the dispersion relation (the defining equation); the group speed is checked by a complex-step derivative
notes.darcy_flow: a finite-difference solution of steady 1-D flow, exact for a uniform medium: Darcy's law restated
notes.stream_power: the rate of potential-energy loss over a 1 m reach by quadrature: the definition rho g Q S restated
notes.rossby_number: U/(f L) with f from MetPy: the definition restated
